---
title: "Computing with the Command-line"
---

In this chapter, you will learn about the command line. The command line is a way to give instructions to a computer by typing words.

You will learn:

- What the command line is.
- How it is different from using a mouse or touch.
- Why the command line is useful, even though it looks simple.
- How to move around files on your computer.
- How to join simple commands together to do bigger tasks (this is called using pipes).
- How to write scripts, so the computer can repeat a set of steps for you.

After this chapter, typing commands will feel normal to you. You will use this skill many times during the course.
